statusSemantics.implemented: Executable code exists; does not imply live verification.
statusSemantics.passed: Specified local evidence passed; platform/scope limits remain explicit.
statusSemantics.partial: Only part of criterion or verification matrix is covered.
statusSemantics.blocked: External target/access or unimplemented dependent fixture prevents verification.

criteria.criterion: Native package валідний за реальною схемою Codex/Agent Plugins
Codex host показує plugin і підтримує enable/disable без ручного skills-only встановлення
criteria.blocker: Verified only on Codex 0.154.0 macOS arm64; portable MCP not discovered.

criteria.criterion: MCP викликається з native install location поза monorepo
Основний bootstrap встановлює client dependencies і реєструє plugin без ручного JSON/TOML редагування
criteria.blocker: macOS client path exercised; Linux/Windows/WSL2 not executed. Project-only Codex scope is blocked.

criteria.criterion: Повторний setup ідемпотентний; interruptions відновлюються; concurrent setup захищений
criteria.blocker: Same-host dead lock recovery and repeated offline setup tested; bootstrap interruption/upgrade matrix on all OSes remains incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Download integrity failure блокує запуск; offline/cache miss не приховує мережеві запити
criteria.blocker: Vendor/browser network channels still require per-platform clean-machine evidence; Playwright browser payload integrity is delegated to Playwright.

criteria.criterion: Existing Codex settings, Java/Node і чужі plugins не пошкоджуються
criteria.blocker: Unrelated Codex setting and reused runtimes checked; foreign plugin and every upgrade/failure path require additional fixture coverage.

criteria.criterion: New-app template проходить реальний Oracle compiler validation
Existing-app export/adopt не затирає local edits і не губить компоненти
criteria.blocker: App 175 import changes only page 1; other 20 exported files including login/global pages and shared LOVs remain byte-identical to baseline. Repeated final import preserves all 21 exported files. Broader no-op normalization/component fixtures remain incomplete.

criteria.criterion: `.apex` metadata/MMD зберігаються; unsupported capability не симулюється
criteria.blocker: App 175 post-import MMD and 20 unaffected exported files preserve their original bytes; repeated final import/export is stable. Unsupported-component rejection matrix remains required.

criteria.criterion: Source mutation після plan і target drift блокують apply
criteria.blocker: Source and target-drift behavior tested with fixtures; actual DB drift requires an authorized target.

criteria.criterion: Target DB/service/workspace/schema/app ID перевірені перед write
criteria.blocker: Actual app 175 built-MCP apply executes fresh DB/service/schema/workspace/app checks before import and after completion. Mismatch failures are unit fixtures; full connected negative matrix remains incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Existing-app backup створений та перевірений до import; restore має окремий plan
criteria.blocker: Four actual app 175 imports created and verified complete SQL backups before writes; final backup hashes rechecked. Actual Oracle restore and restore-failure evidence remains open.

criteria.criterion: Migrations checksum/journal працюють; немає сліпого повторного застосування
criteria.blocker: Default local checksum/history persistence, started-before-execution and interruption protection passed in fixtures. Actual Oracle DDL interruption/reconciliation remains unverified; database journal mode is optional.

criteria.criterion: Одночасні deploys із різних runners до одного target координуються
criteria.blocker: Actual separate Node runner contention is verified within one local managed home/schema. Independent homes/machines require external serialization or optional DB control; real distributed Oracle contention remains unverified.

criteria.criterion: Timeout/cancel/disconnect обробляють `outcome_unknown` і reconciliation
criteria.blocker: Timeout/unknown write state tested with fixtures and real subprocess timeout; real DB disconnect/process-tree termination and reconciliation matrix incomplete.

criteria.criterion: Production не виконується через самостійно проставлений агентом `approved=true`
criteria.blocker: Strict schema and missing production authority rejection tested. Protected-runner signature/approval integration is not configured.

criteria.criterion: utPLSQL suite дає реальний результат; framework відсутній не означає passed
criteria.blocker: Actual megasport probe sees no UT package. No utPLSQL suite was run; the empty required SQL suite fails the quality gate.

criteria.criterion: Browser E2E доводить authenticated CRUD і negative validation, не лише HTTP 200
criteria.blocker: Authenticated Codex in-app dashboard filters, dates, charts and real empty state are verified. This page is not a CRUD fixture; automated authenticated CRUD/negative validation and mobile breakpoint coverage remain absent.

Update/uninstall не пошкоджують user projects, backups або чужі configurations
criteria.blocker: Product uninstall checked in clean profile; full cross-version/platform update/rollback coverage incomplete.

criteria.blocker: Local artifact/site versions and checksums only. No remote GitHub/apex.rest publication.

Документація відрізняє verified/experimental/planned можливості та platform profiles

Sandbox, якщо позначений supported, реально provision-ить стек і не видаляє дані через звичайний `down`

amendments.rule: Clean supported APEX deployment requires no APEXREST service tables; local control is default.

An explicit named development/test application request includes its necessary import; record actual user authorization in exact-plan short-lived grants. Applicable application-only checks may replace unrelated suites only with user-approved scope; no absent suite is passed.
